# Phone Standardizer — Full LLM Context

Owned and maintained by **HobbyHabbit LLC** under the **MIT License**.

## Core API (`phone_standardizer`)
- `standardize_phone(raw_phone, country=None, default_country="US", address_context=None) -> StandardizedPhone`
- `validate_phone(raw_phone, country=None, default_country="US") -> bool`
- `format_e164(raw_phone, country=None, default_country="US") -> str | None`
- `format_national(raw_phone, country=None, default_country="US") -> str | None`
- `format_international(raw_phone, country=None, default_country="US") -> str | None`
- `format_rfc3966(raw_phone, country=None, default_country="US") -> str | None`
- `mask_phone(raw_phone, strategy="partial", country=None, default_country="US") -> str`
- `batch_standardize_phones(records, default_country="US") -> list[StandardizedPhone]`
- `stream_standardize_csv(input_path, output_path, phone_col="phone", country_col="country", default_country="US") -> int`
- `stream_standardize_jsonl(input_path, output_path, phone_key="phone", country_key="country", default_country="US") -> int`
- `get_dial_plan(identifier) -> CountryDialPlan | None`
